content_zh:
“你们懂个毛，滚一边去！”一名魁梧的少年，浓眉大眼，虎背熊腰，能有七尺之高，异于常人的大手，猛地扇了两个孩子一巴掌。
这名少年叫龙虎，虽人高马大，相貌粗犷，但实际才十三岁，是无天在龙村仅有的一个朋友，其原因，每一次出去狩猎时，都会让他算命卜卦，预知凶险。
别说还真灵，每次按照无天的指示，他都能逢凶化吉，满载归来，久而久之，两人成了好友。
“林山前辈，别听他们胡说，无天这些年一直很努力，每日清晨都会去后山之巅，吐纳朝气，年复一年，从未放弃，我想他不能开启体魄，必有其它关系，而且我也相信他不会死。”龙虎认真道。
“是吗？难道真是我猜错了？”
林山心中疑惑，其他村民不知，但他对无天的身世，可一清二楚，早在十年前，龙山就将事情的始料，对他尽数讲述，在他的心里，始终认为无天将来必定会成为了不得的人物，岂料会是这种结果。
林山再度望向不远处的老人，他知道龙山懂得算命之术，必定知道无天的生死，想从中看出一些什么，但后者始终平平淡淡，难以猜测心里在想什么。
“林长老，死了就算了，快点开始吧！”华服少年不耐烦说道。
“谁说我死了？”
这时，一道颇为戏谑的声音响起，众人举目望去，却见一道血红的身影，大步行了过来。那是一名少年，身高七尺，身形挺拔，浑身血迹，眸子黝黑而深邃，宛如一个黑洞，能把人的心神摄了进去。
“天儿！”龙山霍然起身，浑浊的眸子，终于泛出一丝色彩。
“爷爷！”无天快步跑到龙山身前，噗通一声，跪在地上，望着面容憔悴的老人，心如刀割般疼痛，豆大的眼泪，滴落而下。
“爷爷，天儿回来了，对不起，让你担心这么多天，天儿不孝，天儿混蛋，天儿不是人……”无天一边说着，一边狠狠的扇着脸庞。
“住手！”
龙山急忙阻止，伸出颤抖的手，将他搀扶起来，慈爱道：“能安全回来，爷爷已经非常开心，别再伤害自己，爷爷这把骨头，可再也经不起折腾了。”
“爷爷，对不起，是天儿的错，让你担心了。”
龙山道：“傻孩子，你何错之有，要怪只能怪那该死的妖兽，将你逼下悬崖，你受苦了。”
“妖兽？”无天一愣，旋即恍悟，看了眼龙河，正欲开口，便被打断。
“小天啊，你终于回来了，怎么样，没受伤吧！”龙河关心道，大步上前，非常热情，而临近之后，却低声道：“我警告你，若是敢把事情泄露出去，我杀了你爷爷。”
“你……”无天怒目相视。

“我说到做到。”
龙河眸中寒光一闪即逝，伸手拍向无天肩膀，却缩了回来，惊恐的看了看其肩上的黑色小兽，微笑道：“不错，不仅安全回来，身体也强壮不少，以后有机会开启体魄。”
无天身躯一僵，龙河的狠话他绝不怀疑。
原本他是打算当着众人的面，揭穿龙河的真面目，但现在他不得不深层考虑，如今他开启了体魄，进入火云宗已是铁定的事实，若是真将一个月前发生的事情说出来，恐怕在场的也没有几人会相信，如此反而量下大祸。
“臭小子，没看见我老人家在这？几年没见，还是这副德行，一点尊老爱幼的品德都没。”林山上前，敲了敲无天额头，笑骂道。
无天吃疼，暂时搁下揭发龙河的想法，憨笑道：“林叔，好多年没见，天儿以为终生不得相见呢！”
“臭小子，几年不见都长这么高了。”林山颇为的感概，双手在无天肩上，猛力拍下。
“砰”的一声，脚下一个趔趄，无天毫无形象的被拍倒在地。
林山错愕，捎了捎脑袋，尴尬道：“小天，林叔忘记你没有修炼，不好意思哈！下次下手轻点。”
“一次就受不了，还有下次，不要了小爷的小命才怪。”无天狼狈的爬起来，直翻白眼，也不想下你什么修为，就算如今开启了体魄，也受不了你那一掌。
“哼，等小爷强大后，镇压你一百遍。”
无天也只是想想，眼前此人是爷爷的朋友，他再了解不过，性格直爽，没有其他俢者的狂傲，待人和善，对爷孙两照顾有加，不时送来食物，供两人生活。

content_en:
"You know nothing, get out of here!" A burly young man, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, a sturdy back, about seven feet tall, and unusually big hands, slapped the two children fiercely.
This boy's name is Longhu. Although he is tall and rough-looking, he is actually only thirteen years old. He is Wutian's only friend in Longcun. The reason is that every time he goes hunting, he will ask him to tell fortunes and predict dangers.
Not to mention being really smart, every time he followed Wutian's instructions, he could turn disaster into good luck and return with a full load. Over time, the two became good friends.
"Senior Lin Shan, don't listen to their nonsense. Wutian has been working hard these years. He goes to the top of the back mountain every morning to breathe out his vitality. Year after year, he never gives up. I think he cannot open up his body. There must be other reasons. And I also believe that he will not die." Longhu said seriously.
"Really? Did I really guess wrong?"
Lin Shan was confused, and the other villagers didn't know it, but he knew Wutian's life experience clearly. As early as ten years ago, Longshan told him everything about the incident. In his heart, he always believed that Wutian would definitely become a great person in the future. How could he have expected this result.
Lin Shan looked at the old man not far away again. He knew that Longshan knew the art of fortune telling and must know Wutian's life and death. He wanted to see something from it, but the latter was always dull and it was difficult to guess what was in his heart.
"Elder Lin, forget it if you die, let's start quickly!" said the young man in colorful clothes impatiently.
"Who said I'm dead?"
At this time, a rather joking voice sounded, and everyone looked up, only to see a blood-red figure striding over. It was a young man, seven feet tall, tall and erect, covered in blood, with dark and deep eyes, like a black hole that could suck in a person's mind.
"Tian'er!" Longshan suddenly stood up, his cloudy eyes finally showing a hint of color.
"Grandpa!" Wutian quickly ran to Longshan, and with a pop, he knelt on the ground, looking at the haggard old man, his heart hurt like a knife, and big tears fell down.
"Grandpa, Tian'er is back. I'm sorry for making you worry for so many days. Tian'er is unfilial, Tian'er is a bastard, Tian'er is not a human being..." Wutian said while slapping his face hard.
"Stop!"
Longshan hurriedly stopped him, stretched out his trembling hands, helped him up, and said lovingly: "Grandpa is very happy to be back safely. Don't hurt yourself again. Grandpa's bones can no longer withstand the torture."
"Grandpa, I'm sorry. It's Tian'er's fault for making you worry."
Longshan said: "Silly boy, what's wrong with you? If you want to blame me, you can only blame that damn monster for forcing you off the cliff. You suffered."
"Monster?" Wutian was stunned for a moment, then suddenly realized, he glanced at Long He, and was about to speak when he was interrupted.
"Little God, you're finally back. How are you? You're not hurt!" Long He asked with concern, striding forward with great enthusiasm. But as he approached, he whispered: "I'm warning you, if you dare to leak the matter, I will kill your grandfather."
"You..." Wutian glared at each other.
"I keep my word."
The cold light in Long He's eyes flashed away, and he reached out to pat Wutian's shoulder, but he retracted, looked at the little black beast on his shoulder in horror, and said with a smile: "Not bad, not only are you back safely, but your body is also much stronger. I will have the opportunity to open up your body in the future."
Wu Tian stiffened, he had no doubt about Long He's cruel words.
Originally, he planned to expose Long He's true face in front of everyone, but now he had to think deeply. Now that he has activated his body and entered the Fire Cloud Sect, it is an ironclad fact. If he really tells what happened a month ago, I am afraid that not many people present will believe it. This will only cause great disaster.
"You brat, didn't you see my old man here? I haven't seen him for several years, but he still behaves like this. He has no moral character of respecting the old and caring for the young." Lin Shan stepped forward and knocked on the door.Knocked Wutian on the forehead and cursed with a smile.
Wutian felt pain, temporarily put aside the idea of exposing Long He, and said with a naive smile: "Uncle Lin, I haven't seen you for many years, Tian'er thought that we would never see each other again in our lifetime!"
"You brat, I haven't seen you grow so tall in a few years." Lin Shan was quite impressed. He put his hands on Wutian's shoulders and patted him hard.
There was a "bang", his feet staggered, and Wutian was knocked to the ground without any image.
Lin Shan was stunned, raised his head, and said awkwardly: "Xiaotian, Uncle Lin forgot that you didn't practice, I'm sorry! Be gentle next time."
"I can't bear it once. It will be weird if I take my life next time." Wutian got up in embarrassment and rolled his eyes. He didn't want to do anything about your cultivation. Even if he has activated his body now, he still can't stand your palm.
"Hmph, when I get stronger, I will suppress you a hundred times."
Wu Tian just thought about it. The person in front of him was his grandfather's friend. He knew him well. He had a straightforward personality and was not as arrogant as other people. He was kind to others and took good care of his grandfather and grandson. He would send food to them from time to time to support them.
